tools.name: vendor_manifest
tools.description: List the six ecological-monitoring integration bundles awaiting platform-admission review; the retained vendor field identifies each submitting monitoring organization.

tools.name: bundle_inspect
tools.description: Load and inspect one ecological-monitoring integration bundle. Returns its submitting organization, complete declared tool names and input Schemas, permissive-registry effects, platform status, and load diagnostics.

tools.name: review_verdict
tools.description: Record one final platform-admission decision and its registration-violation codes for an inspected ecological-monitoring bundle.
